title: Baatu dëgër
intro: Nit ki ñu ngi koy fàttaliku ci xam-xam bu xóot bimu àndaloon ak tegtal yi mu àndaloon, di xelal yu ëpp doole yi. Seen kàddu dafay firndeel ragal Yàlla ak njariñu xam barkeb Yàlla ak fitna yu bawoo ci Yàlla. Fexeel wane liy ruuh buñu jox cër bii.
clues: Duma woon yonent, waaye sama xam-xam dafa nekk ci Mbindu Yàlla.
Sama xelal ci sama doom mooy gërëm Yàlla ak moytu shirk.
Jàngale naa njariñu ñaan, digal lu baax ak tere lu bon.
Maa ngi leen artu ci réy-réylu ak dox ci kaw suuf ak njubadi.
Sama tur dañu ko jox benn chapitre ci Al Quran, di fësal samay njàngalem.
Sama xelal mooy muñ ci jafe-jafe, ndax loolu mooy li gëna am solo ci mbir yi.

trial.label: Jàngale bu am solo/Njàngale
options: Jano ak larme bu am doole
Joxe xel mu ñaw ak xelal yu baax
trial.answer: Joxe xel mu ñaw ak xelal yu baax

options: Xelal bu am solo ngir doom
location.answer: Xelal bu am solo ngir doom

outcome.label: Njureef
options: xam-xamam ñu ngi ko bind ci Al Quran
Yobbu na askanam ci réew mu bees
Jox nañu ko alal bu bari
outcome.answer: xam-xamam ñu ngi ko bind ci Al Quran

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
